_comment: Corrections applied to the CAEN Rev.3 denominations extracted from Ordinul INS 377/2024, MO I 385/25.04.2024. The raw, uncorrected text is preserved in caen_rev3_mo385_raw.txt. Every entry states what was wrong. Decided by the user 2026-10-14: ship corrected text, single denumire field, comma-below diacritics.
_diacritics: All ş/ţ (comma-above, U+015F/U+0163) normalised to ș/ț (comma-below, U+0219/U+021B) at ingest. The source PDF mixes both, sometimes inside one entry (0163).

corrections.why: double genitive plural; matches CAEN Rev.2 and NACE 23.66
double genitive plural; matches CAEN Rev.2
vowel error; pattern is comma-below because diacritics are normalised before corrections are applied

deliberately_not_changed.why: correct as published and matches CAEN Rev.2; caen3.ro shows tuberculilor, which is the error
the term used in the official text; not our call to modernise

deliberately_not_changed.text: producția de generatoare de abur și boilere
deliberately_not_changed.why: odd but plausible as published; no independent evidence it is wrong

deliberately_not_changed.text: SECȚIUNEA G - COMERȚ CU RIDICATA ȘI CU AMĂNUNTUL;
deliberately_not_changed.why: the title ends in a semicolon, so the PDF line looks truncated. The Rev.2 title continued with the repair of motor vehicles. Rev.3 moved that activity to 467/478 and 953, so a shortened title is defensible. NOT completed by inference — flagged as unresolved.
